verdict.rationale: SolidJS provides Context and Stores as built-in mechanisms for sharing state/dependencies across components without third-party libraries, and components-as-functions let developers freely organize code into modular units (solid-gh-2, solid-gh-14). However, there's no explicit dependency-injection pattern (e.g., injectable services/tokens) documented, and no community evidence discussing DI usage specifically. Missing for 10: dedicated DI examples/patterns beyond Context, first-party guide on modular service injection, and independent corroboration of this pattern in practice.
